faqs.question: What is the expression® CMS used for?
faqs.answer: It's a compact benchtop mass spectrometer used for reaction monitoring, compound identification, and applications spanning teaching, food safety, environmental, clinical, and forensic analysis.

faqs.question: What sampling techniques does expression CMS support?
faqs.answer: From prep-free direct probe analysis using ASAP or iASAP, through Touch Express open-port sampling and Plate Express TLC reading, up to full LC integration via AVANT Modular (U)HPLC.

faqs.question: How do I choose between the two mass range options?
faqs.answer: Choose m/z 10-1,200 for most standard organic chemistry work, or m/z 10-2,000 if your compounds regularly extend into larger mass ranges.

faqs.question: How do I set up expression CMS for fast reaction monitoring?
faqs.answer: Use the direct probe sampling technique (ASAP or iASAP), which requires no sample preparation, for the fastest possible in-process check.

faqs.question: How do I switch between sampling techniques?
faqs.answer: Interfaces are designed to swap rapidly with minimal sample preparation; confirm your specific technique combination and switching workflow with Inkarp.

faqs.question: Is expression CMS suitable for a teaching laboratory?
faqs.answer: Yes, it's a confirmed application area, with a dedicated product note covering hands-on mass spectrometry experiments for teaching labs.

faqs.question: Can expression CMS integrate with liquid chromatography?
faqs.answer: Yes, via AVANT Modular (U)HPLC, providing full compound separation for samples that need it.

faqs.question: What applications is expression CMS confirmed for?
faqs.answer: Reaction monitoring, teaching chemistry, food safety and ingredients analysis, cannabis and hemp testing, environmental analysis, clinical diagnostics, proteins and peptides synthesis, and forensics.

faqs.question: What is the price of the expression® CMS in India?
faqs.answer: The price depends on your mass range option and sampling interface configuration. Contact Inkarp for a quotation once your application is confirmed.

faqs.question: Who is the authorized distributor of the expression® CMS in India?
faqs.answer: Inkarp is the authorized distributor and service provider for the Advion Interchim Scientific expression® CMS in India, providing demonstration, installation, training, AMC, spare parts, and technical support.

longForm.heroLead: Most labs need more than one way to look at a sample. A quick probe touch for a fast answer, and full chromatographic separation when the mixture actually needs pulling apart. expression CMS is built to do both on the same instrument. Switch between direct probe analysis requiring no preparation at all, and full LC-integrated separation, in the time it takes to change the sampling interface. Choose a system covering m/z 10 to 1,200, or extend to 2,000 for larger compounds. It's designed specifically around how chemists actually work: fast answers during reaction monitoring, straightforward enough for a teaching lab, and versatile enough to support food safety, environmental, and forensic analysis on the same platform.

sections.title: Sampling Technique Ecosystem
sections.tabSummary: Matching the right interface to your workflow
body: Choosing a sampling technique is really choosing how much sample preparation your workflow can afford, and how much separation your compound actually needs.

At one end, direct probe analysis via ASAP or iASAP needs no sample preparation at all, ideal for a fast reaction-monitoring check. Touch Express extends that simplicity to an open-port sampling interface. Plate Express reads directly from TLC plates. At the other end, AVANT Modular (U)HPLC brings full liquid chromatography integration, for compounds that genuinely need separating before identification.
